title: Pivotal count bound from CNF width
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $w$ be a natural number, and suppose $f$ is represented by a CNF formula of width at most $w$. At every cube point, the number of coordinates where $f$ equals $1$ and is pivotal is at most $w$.
